dimensions.assessment: Affects the U.S. Treasury, the U.S. Executive Director at the IDB, the U.S. International Development Finance Corporation, and entities involved in IDB-financed operations across member countries.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary of the Treasury, in consultation with the Secretary of State, shall instruct the United States Executive Director at the Inter-American Development Bank

dimensions.assessment: Directs formal voting positions, extensive project reviews for national security risks, sanctions and export control checks, and detailed historical and ongoing reporting.
dimensions.evidence: voting against... any project, or loan, grant, or other financing, that... the United States Executive Director or the Secretary of the Treasury determines poses a risk

dimensions.assessment: Requires extensive administrative reviews, data collection, and multi-year reporting by the Department of the Treasury and Department of State, though direct appropriations are not stated.
dimensions.evidence: the Secretary, in consultation with the Secretary of State, shall submit to the appropriate congressional committees a report

dimensions.assessment: Directs U.S. foreign policy voting instructions within an international financial institution and establishes comprehensive statutory reporting requirements covering all IDB projects since 2009.
dimensions.evidence: A complete list of all projects of the IDB that include financing or funding from the PRC, PRC entities, or PRC trust funds created at the IDB since the PRC joined

dimensions.assessment: Mandates initial reports and subsequent recurring reports every two years for an 8-year period.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 2 years after the Secretary submits the report required by subsection (a), and every 2 years thereafter for 8 years

missing_information: No specific dollar amounts for IDB capital contributions or direct federal spending authorizations are specified in the bill text.
The operational costs for the Treasury and State Departments to compile the historical project lists are not estimated.
importance_detail.rationale: The Strengthening United States Leadership at the IDB Act directs the U.S. Executive Director at the Inter-American Development Bank to oppose PRC influence and procurement, encourages DFC collaboration, and mandates comprehensive initial and recurring reports on IDB projects involving PRC entities.
